req.title: Player POST accepts nickname optionally
req.statement: The system shall accept POST /players/ payloads without a nickname field and treat nickname as optional.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-040 states that nickname (which maps to no field in the schema — the optional fields in PlayerRequestModel are middle_name, date_of_birth, abbr_position, team, league, starting11) is optional on POST /players/. More precisely, the requirement means the system must accept a POST payload that omits any optional field and still return HTTP 201. We test: (1) positive — payload with all required fields only, no optional fields, expects 201; (2) negative — payload missing a required field (first_name), expects 422; (3) boundary — payload with exactly the minimal required fields plus one optional field set to null explicitly, expects 201; (4) decision-table — payload that includes all optional fields set to non-null values, expects 201; (5) boundary — squad number at the edge of existing data (27, one above the highest seeded value 26) to confirm uniqueness constraint is not violated. All tests use squad numbers not present in the pre-loaded fixture (27, 28, 29, 30, 31) to remain idempotent.

tests.name: test_post_player_without_any_optional_fields_returns_201
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 rows; squad numbers 1-26 are taken
Squad number 27 does not exist in the database
actions: POST /players/ with only required fields: first_name, last_name, squad_number, position
Omit all optional fields: middle_name, date_of_birth, abbr_position, team, league, starting11
expected: Response body contains id (UUID), firstName, lastName, squadNumber=27, position
Optional fields in response are null/None
trace: R-PLAYER-040: system shall accept POST /players/ without optional fields
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_without_any_optional_fields_returns_201():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "TestFirst",
        "lastName": "TestLast",
        "squadNumber": 27,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["firstName"] == "TestFirst"
    assert body["lastName"] == "TestLast"
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 27
    assert body["position"] == "Goalkeeper"
    assert body["middleName"] is None
    assert body["dateOfBirth"] is None
    assert body["abbrPosition"] is None
    assert body["team"] is None
    assert body["league"] is None
    assert body["starting11"] is None
    assert "id" in body

test_post_player_without_any_optional_fields_returns_201()
